question: Why can undifferentiated factors not be posited as causes of meaning-cognition?
premises: Undifferentiated factors would not serve as causes of cognition.
Therefore cognition of meaning cannot be posited from them.
inference: Undifferentiated factors cannot be the basis for positing meaning-cognition.
plain_english: They would not be causes of cognition; therefore cognition of the meaning cannot be posited on that basis.
